results.name: AT&T Inc.
results.description: AT&T Inc. (formerly SBC Communications Inc.) provides telecommunications services to consumers and businesses in the United States and internationally. The company was founded on the 5th of October 1983 as Southwestern Bell Corp. On November 18, 2005, the firm acquired AT&T Corp. and adopted the AT&T Inc. name shortly afterwards.

results.name: AT&T Mexico Inc.
results.description: AT&T Mexico Inc. is a telecommunications company, founded in 2000 as a subsidiary of AT&T Inc.

results.name: AT&T Corp.
results.description: AT&T Corp., originally American Telephone and Telegraph Co., is an American telecommunications company that provides voice, video, data, and Internet telecommunications and professional services to businesses, consumers, and government agencies. It was founded in 1885. SBC Communications Inc. bought AT&T Corp. on November 18, 2005 and renamed themselves AT&T Inc.

results.name: AT&T Mobility II LLC
results.description: AT&T Mobility II LLC, a subsidiary of AT&T, Inc., is a company headquartered in Atlanta, GA. The firm provides DSL internet, local and long-distance voice and data services. Provides DSL internet, local and long-distance voice and data services.
